lines.en: label yumislumber1:
if tsuneyoslumber3 == False:
scene mayanebench30
I tap on Yumi’s name in “my” phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在「我的」手机里点了 Yumi 的名字，等她接。

lines.en: : Uhh...hello?
: Hey.
: Who the fuck is this?
lines.zh: : 你他妈是谁？

lines.en: : Your teacher. I’m calling you from my new secret phone number.
lines.zh: : 你的老师。我用我新的秘密号码给你打的。

lines.en: : Um...congrats?
lines.zh: : 呃……恭喜？

lines.en: : The fuck you want? Why you callin’ me?
lines.zh: : 你想干嘛？打给我做什么？

lines.en: : Maybe I just miss you?
lines.zh: : 也许我只是想你了？

lines.en: : And maybe I’ve gotta find someone willin’ to give me one of those lobotomy things so I can forget I ever heard that. Later.
lines.zh: : 也许我还得找个人给我做个脑叶切除什么的，好让我忘掉刚才听到的。挂了。

lines.en: : Wait. On a serious note, are you busy right now?
lines.zh: : 等等。说正经的，你现在忙吗？

lines.en: : Yeah.
: With what? You’re unemployed and don’t have a house.
lines.zh: : 忙什么？你又没工作又没房子。

lines.en: : And you’re a fucking douche nozzle! I’m hanging up now!
lines.zh: : 而你这个他妈的混蛋玩意儿！我现在就挂！

lines.en: : Stop whatever it is you’re doing. We need to meet up and continue our conversation from the beach. It’s important and...apparently {i}time{/i}-sensitive.
lines.zh: : 不管你在干什么，先停下。我们得见一面，继续海滩上那次没谈完的话。这事很重要，而且……显然是有{i}时限{/i}的。

lines.en: : That was a hilarious pun that you won't understand. But hopefully, you will soon.
lines.zh: : 这是个你听不懂的绝妙双关。不过希望你能很快就懂。

lines.en: : Can't. Chinami's got a fever. You want me to leave her alone so I can come talk to {i}you{/i} about my random ass memory issues?
lines.zh: : 不行。Chinami 发烧了。你想让我丢下她，跑{i}来{/i}跟你聊我那破记性问题？

lines.en: : Chinami’s sick?
lines.zh: : Chinami 病了？

lines.en: : Yeah. And I’m stuck at {i}your girlfriend’s{/i} house watchin’ her until the mall closes and Chika comes back home.
lines.zh: : 对。我被困在{i}你女朋友{/i}家里看着她，要等到商场关门、Chika 回来。

lines.en: : Great. I’ll meet you there.
lines.zh: : 很好。我去那儿找你。

lines.en: : The fuck you will! Were you not payin’ attention when I told you Chinami’s sick?! She needs rest!
lines.zh: : 你去个屁！我刚说 Chinami 病了你没听见吗？！她需要休息！

lines.en: : {i}Is that Chinami’s papa?! The new one, not the one who abandoned her!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是 Chinami 的爸爸吗？！是新的那个，不是抛弃她的那个！{/i}

lines.en: : No! It’s the fucking...bank.
lines.zh: : 不是！是那个该死的……银行。

lines.en: : {i}Did Chinami’s recent deposit clear?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Chinami 最近的存款到账了吗？{/i}

lines.en: : I’ll see you soon, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 待会儿见，Yumi。

lines.en: : Don’t you fucking-
lines.zh: : 你他妈别——

lines.en: if tsuneyoslumber3 == False:
scene black
I hang up the phone and begin to make my way over to the second half of town.
lines.zh: 我挂了电话，动身前往镇子的另一半。

lines.en: Thankfully, I am no longer completely bewildered in terms of my location and am able to make it to the bus stop without any issues at all.
lines.zh: 幸好我不再对自己的位置一头雾水，顺利地走到了公交站，中途没出任何岔子。

lines.en: And while I’d normally just bite the bullet and walk there, I’m admittedly a little worried about Chinami and would like to make sure I see her at least one more time before she dies.
lines.zh: 虽然平时我会咬咬牙直接走过去，但说实话我有点担心 Chinami，想在她死之前至少再见她一面。

lines.en: I kid, of course. Kind of.
lines.zh: 当然是开玩笑。算是吧。

lines.en: I don’t know.
lines.zh: 我不知道。

lines.en: Maybe Maki’s morbid sense of humor has just rubbed off on me after all the time I spent with her during Makoto's tragic arc.
lines.zh: 也许是在 Makoto 那段悲剧剧情里跟 Maki 待久了，被她那套病态幽默传染了。

lines.en: Regardless, I double check the bus schedule on my new backup phone and take a seat on the bench, waiting patiently for it to arrive and carry me toward my current goal.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我在新的备用手机上又核对了一遍公交时刻表，然后在长椅上坐下，耐心地等车来，把我带向当下的目标。

lines.en: Here’s hoping Yumi likes sleepovers.
lines.zh: 但愿 Yumi 喜欢在外过夜。

lines.en: scene yumicurtain1
: Hey, I’m here.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我到了。

lines.en: : Yeah, I can see that! The Hell do you think you are, just walkin’ into somebody else’s house?!
lines.zh: : 是啊，我看得见！你他妈以为自己是谁，随随便便就走进别人家里？！

lines.en: : In my defense, it’s not like you didn’t know I was coming.
lines.zh: : 为我辩护一句，你又不是不知道我要来。

lines.en: : That doesn’t make it okay! Go back out there and knock or ring the bell like a normal person!
lines.zh: : 那也不能就这么算了！滚出去，像个正常人一样敲门或者按门铃！

lines.en: : But if I do that, you’ll lock me out.
lines.zh: : 可我要那么做，你会把我锁在外面。

lines.en: scene yumicurtain2
: Tch. Was hopin’ that would work.
lines.zh: : 啧。我本来还指望这招管用呢。

lines.en: : On the bright side, I’m glad to have made it before visiting hours ended. How’s the patient?
lines.zh: : 往好处想，我很高兴在探视时间结束前赶到了。病人怎么样？

lines.en: scene yumicurtain3
: Chinami, how are you?!
lines.zh: : Chinami，你怎么样？！

lines.en: : Chinami is fine! Hi, Papa!
lines.zh: : Chinami 很好！你好，爸爸！

lines.en: : Where did you get such a huge privacy curtain? That’s like, straight out of a hospital.
lines.zh: : 你们从哪儿弄来这么大一幅隔帘？简直像直接从医院搬来的。

lines.en: scene yumicurtain4
: Probably because it {i}is{/i} straight out of a hospital. Shit’s been here longer than I have.
lines.zh: : 大概因为它本来{i}就是{/i}从医院搬来的。这玩意儿在这儿的时间比我还长。

lines.en: : Pretty sure they’ve had it ever since Chinami was born on account of her whole immune thingy.
lines.zh: : 我敢说打从 Chinami 出生起就有了，因为她那个免疫系统的问题。

lines.en: : Chinami used to spend a lot of time behind her safety curtain, but now she only has to use it some- {i}ack!..keh...{/i}
lines.zh: : Chinami 以前要长时间待在她的安全帘后面，不过现在只有时候才需要用——{i}咳！……咳……{/i}

lines.en: scene yumicurtain5
: Hey! Go back to sleep! You know you ain’t gonna get any better if you get all excited and sh...and crap.
lines.zh: : 喂！继续睡！你自己知道，一激动就好不了，还会……还会拉什么的。

lines.en: : That really isn’t much better, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 这也没好到哪儿去啊，Yumi。

lines.en: : Chinami is fine! She just swallowed a bug!
lines.zh: : Chinami 没事！她只是吞了只虫子！

lines.en: scene yumicurtain6
: Just ignore her. She’ll go back to sleep if we don’t pay any attention.
lines.zh: : 别理她。我们不理她，她就会睡回去的。

lines.en: : Is keeping her here okay? Wouldn’t it be better to take her to a hospital or something?
lines.zh: : 让她待在这儿没问题吗？带她去医院什么的不是更好？

lines.en: scene yumicurtain7
: With what money? Tsukasa ain’t paid me yet and you know damn well how much Chika’s got.
lines.zh: : 拿什么钱？Tsukasa 还没付我工钱，Chika 有多少你他妈清楚得很。

lines.en: : I’m sure the Tsukiokas wouldn’t mind fronting the bill if it meant keeping Chinami healthy.
lines.zh: : 我相信月冈家肯定不介意先垫付这笔钱，只要能让 Chinami 健健康康的。

lines.en: : It’s fine. Shit like this ain’t all that uncommon. Just a normal cold or somethin’. I’ve been givin’ her medicine and her fever’s already started to break and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 没事的。这种事不算稀奇。就是普通感冒什么的。我一直在给她喂药，烧已经开始退了什么的。

lines.en: : Good. It’s not every day I get to see you being responsible. I like this side of you, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 很好。能看到你这么有责任心可不多见。我喜欢你这一面，Yumi。

lines.en: : Only side of you I like is the...one outside of this apartment.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢的你的那一面……是在这间公寓外面的那面。

lines.en: : Good one.
lines.zh: : 说得好。

lines.en: : Suck my left nut. Why are you even here? What do you want?
lines.zh: : 舔我的左蛋。你到底来干嘛？你想怎样？

lines.en: : I told you on the phone, didn’t I? We need to resume our conversation from the beach.
lines.zh: : 我在电话里说了吧？我们得接着海滩那次的话继续谈。

lines.en: scene yumicurtain8
: Probably better off just startin’ from the beginning. Shit confused me so much I can barely even remember what it is we were talkin’ about.
lines.zh: : 大概还是从头讲比较好。那事把我搞懵了，我几乎都想不起来我们当时在聊什么。

lines.en: : Somethin’ with the last two months, right?
lines.zh: : 是跟过去两个月有关的事，对吧？

lines.en: : Right. Did you try talking to anyone else about that after I ran off last night?
lines.zh: : 对。昨晚我跑掉之后，你有跟别人聊过这事吗？

lines.en: : Only person I have to talk to is Chika and it seemed like everything was pretty fuckin’ normal from her point of view. Meanin’ it’s probably only me who-
lines.zh: : 我能说话的人只有 Chika，而在她看来一切都很正常。意思就是说大概只有我——

lines.en: scene yumicurtain9
: Wait! You didn’t give me your fuckin' memory disease, did you?!
lines.zh: : 等等！你该不会把你的记忆病传染给我了吧？！

lines.en: : Yay! Chinami won’t be alone in the safety curtain! She’ll make room for big sis Yumi right now!
lines.zh: : 耶！Chinami 在安全帘里就不会孤单了！她现在就给 Yumi 姐姐腾位置！

lines.en: : I didn’t give you a {i}disease{/i}, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 我没有把{i}病{/i}传染给你，Yumi。

lines.en: : Aww, rats...
lines.zh: : 啊，糟糕……

lines.en: : But just because you’re not terminally ill doesn’t mean this is something we can ignore.
lines.zh: : 不过，你没得绝症，不代表这件事我们可以不管。

lines.en: : Well...I guess technically we {i}could{/i} ignore it and it wouldn’t make much of a difference to you. But it would be a big help for me and a couple other people if you could at least listen for a little while.
lines.zh: : 嗯……严格来说我们确实{i}可以{/i}不管，对你也没什么两样。但如果你肯听我说一会儿，对我和另外几个人会是很大的帮助。

lines.en: scene yumicurtain10
: Okay. So {i}you{/i} want {i}me{/i} to take time out of {i}my{/i} life so that {i}your{/i} life can get better or some shit...while I don’t benefit at all. Am I hearin’ that right?
lines.zh: : 行。所以{i}你{/i}是想让{i}我{/i}抽出{i}我{/i}的人生时间，好让{i}你的{/i}生活变得更好什么的……而我一点好处都没有。我理解得对吗？

lines.en: : More or less.
lines.zh: : 差不多。

lines.en: : Gotcha.
lines.zh: : 明白了。

lines.en: : Welp, you know where the door is.
lines.zh: : 那好吧，门在哪儿你知道。

lines.en: : Yumi, come on. Just hear me out.
lines.zh: : Yumi，拜托。听我说完。

lines.en: scene yumicurtain11
: Ahhhhh, fine! But the second this gets too friggin’ weird I’m calling Gary!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊，行吧！但这事一变得太他妈奇怪，我就叫 Gary！

lines.en: scene black
: Great. Thank you — wait, who’s Gary?
lines.zh: : 太好了。谢谢——等等，Gary 是谁？

lines.en: scene yumicurtain12
I help myself to a pot of coffee left out on the kitchen table and quickly come to understand that this was definitely not made anytime within the last six hours.
lines.zh: 我给自己倒了厨房桌上放着的一壶咖啡，很快就明白这绝对不是过去六个小时内煮的。

lines.en: : You gonna microwave that shit or just pretend it’s drinkable?
lines.zh: : 你是打算把那玩意儿微波一下，还是假装它还能喝？

lines.en: : I made this bed and I now have to lie in it. But that is beside the point.
lines.zh: : 自作自受，我认了。不过这不是重点。

lines.en: : Mhm. And the point is?
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。那重点是什么？

lines.en: : How do you feel about sleepovers?
lines.zh: : 你对在外过夜这事怎么看？

lines.en: scene yumicurtain13
: Why do you exist?
lines.zh: : 你为什么还活着？

lines.en: : Actually, it’s funny you should ask because that’s a big part of why I’m here today.
lines.zh: : 说起来挺巧的，你这么问正好——这正是我今天来这儿的一个重要原因。

lines.en: : It’s like every single thing you say makes shit ten times more confusing.
lines.zh: : 你说的每一句话都让事情变得更混乱十倍。

lines.en: : Then I’ll fulfill your greatest wish and shut up while you do your best to recollect the last two months of your life.
lines.zh: : 那我就满足你最大的愿望，闭嘴，让你好好回忆一下过去两个月的人生。

lines.en: scene yumicurtain14
: Looks like we’re both gonna shut the fuck up, then. Cause that’s exactly what I was tryin’ to do ever since you pointed shit out and I’ve got nothin’.
lines.zh: : 那看来我们俩都得闭嘴了。因为从你点破那事之后，我一直在试着回忆，可什么都没想起来。

lines.en: : If you know what’s goin’ on with me, fucking spill it. Because all the shit I keep hearin’ about the space between Halloween and Christmas is makin’ my head spin.
lines.zh: : 你要是知道我身上发生了什么，就他妈说出来。因为我老是听到关于万圣节到圣诞节之间那段空白的各种说法，搞得我头都晕了。

lines.en: : Didn’t think much of it at first, but I straight up can’t even picture any of it when I try to. It’s like all that time was just fuckin’...ripped outta my mind or somethin’.
lines.zh: : 一开始我没当回事，可现在我真的连一点画面都想不起来。就好像那段时间被他妈的……从我的脑子里挖掉了一样。

lines.en: : That what it’s like for you too? You know, with all your memory shit.
lines.zh: : 你也是这种感觉吗？就你那堆记性问题。

lines.en: scene yumicurtain15
: More or less. Just it’s a lot more than two months for me and I also, occasionally, do things like black out and force myself on teenage girls.
lines.zh: : 差不多。只不过对我来说不止两个月，而且我偶尔还会昏过去，对未成年少女动手动脚。

lines.en: : Those “blackouts” have somethin’ to do with it too? That shit ain’t gonna start happenin’ to me next, is it?
lines.zh: : 那些「断片」也跟这有关？那玩意儿接下来不会也找上我吧？

lines.en: : I have no idea. And I’m probably not even the right person to lead a conversation like this since I have very little understanding of how {i}anything{/i} works.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。而且我大概也不是主导这种对话的合适人选，因为我自己对这{i}一切{/i}的运作方式也几乎一无所知。

lines.en: : But you’re an outlier right now...so I do know that the logical course of action would be trying to figure out {i}why.{/i}
lines.zh: : 但你现在是个异常值……所以我知道，合乎逻辑的做法是试着弄清楚{i}原因{/i}。

lines.en: : The fuck is an “outlier?”
lines.zh: : 「异常值」是什么鬼？

lines.en: : Something that skews what’s meant to be an average.
lines.zh: : 就是会把平均值拉偏的东西。

lines.en: : For example, if we calculated the mean age of everyone in class, {i}I{/i} would be the outlier since I’m way older than all of you and would force that mean upward.
lines.zh: : 比如说，如果我们算全班人的平均年龄，{i}我{/i}就是那个异常值，因为我比你们所有人都大得多，会把平均值往上拉。

lines.en: scene yumicurtain16
: Good. So you {i}do{/i} understand that. Now think long and hard about why that makes you such a fucking creep.
lines.zh: : 很好。这么说你{i}是{/i}明白的。那就好好想想，为什么这让你变成了一个这么恶心的变态。

lines.en: : I have plenty of time to think about how horrible of a person I am. But, for reasons I am mostly incapable of explaining, you might not have equal time to do the same when it comes to this.
lines.zh: : 我有的是时间反省自己有多烂。但出于一些我基本解释不清的原因，在这件事上，你未必有同样多的时间。

lines.en: scene yumicurtain17
: Huh? I ain’t gonna, like...die or some shit, am I?
lines.zh: : 哈？我不会……要死了什么的吧？

lines.en: : Nothing that serious, no.
lines.zh: : 没那么严重，不会。

lines.en: : Then what? My memories just gonna, like...come back or something?
lines.zh: : 那是什么？我的记忆会……自己回来什么的？

lines.en: : They might.
lines.zh: : 有这个可能。

lines.en: : I ain’t seein’ what the big deal is, then.
lines.zh: : 那我看不出有什么大不了的。

lines.en: : Would you see the “big deal” if I told you those two months may have never even happened in the first place? And that everyone’s memories of it were just false?
lines.zh: : 如果我告诉你，那两个月可能根本就没发生过，所有人对它的记忆都是假的，你会觉得「大不了」吗？

lines.en: : Uhh...no. But I {i}would{/i} call you a fucking lunatic.
lines.zh: : 呃……不。但我{i}会{/i}说你是他妈的疯子。

lines.en: : If everybody’s got memories of those months and it's just you and me who don’t, wouldn’t {i}we{/i} be the ones...in the wrong or whatever?
lines.zh: : 如果所有人都有那几个月的记忆，就只有你我没有，那出问题的不应该是{i}我们{/i}俩吗？

lines.en: : This is less about who is wrong and who is right and more about {i}why{/i} we’re in the position we’re in.
lines.zh: : 这与其说是谁对谁错的问题，不如说是我们{i}为什么{/i}会处在这样的处境里。

lines.en: : Isn’t it strange knowing there could be something different about you, Yumi?
lines.zh: : 知道自己身上可能有什么不一样的地方，你不觉得奇怪吗，Yumi？

lines.en: scene yumicurtain18
: Not...really.
lines.zh: : 不……怎么觉得。

lines.en: : I’ve been different my whole fuckin’ life, man. And I’ve been hearin’ all about it since the first time I knocked somebody’s lights out in daycare.
lines.zh: : 我这辈子他妈一直都跟别人不一样，老兄。打从我在托儿所第一次把人打晕开始，这种话我就听够了。

lines.en: : Might’ve wound up a better person if somebody looked after me now and then, but I’m well adjusted to not fitting in already.
lines.zh: : 要是有人偶尔照顾过我，我也许能变成更好的人，不过我已经很习惯格格不入了。

lines.en: : This is different, though. This is-
lines.zh: : 可这次不一样。这次是——

lines.en: : No shit it’s different. This is like, some...borderline supernatural shit.
lines.zh: : 当然不一样，这还用说。这简直就是……某种超自然的东西。

lines.en: : But if {i}you’ve{/i} got no idea why this is happenin’ and everybody {i}else{/i} is just gonna be weird if we try and talk about it, the Hell’s the point in even trying in the first place?
lines.zh: : 可{i}你{/i}要是根本不知道为什么会这样，而{i}别人{/i}听我们谈论这事也只会觉得奇怪，那一开始费那个劲干嘛？

lines.en: : Can’t say I’d feel the same way if I lost as much time and memory as you, but it’s just two months. And those two months weren’t really all that bad from what I understand.
lines.zh: : 我要是像你一样丢了那么多时间和记忆，我可说不出这种话。但我就两个月而已。而且据我所知，那两个月也不算太糟。

lines.en: : Wound up back in school, didn’t I? That’s gotta be a plus, right?
lines.zh: : 我最后不是回学校了吗？这总算是件好事吧？

lines.en: : Is that what you wanted, though? I thought you were planning on dropping out?
lines.zh: : 可那是你想要的吗？我记得你本来打算退学的？

lines.en: : I don’t know. Last I remember, I was still trying to figure shit out.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我最后记得的，是我还在想办法弄明白。

lines.en: : I’m surprised you’re okay with the universe just deciding things for you, then.
lines.zh: : 那我倒是挺意外，你居然能接受让老天替你做决定。

lines.en: scene yumicurtain19
: Nobody decided shit for me. The only person who chooses what I’m gonna do is myself.
lines.zh: : 没人替我决定任何事。决定我要做什么的只有我自己。

lines.en: : Then what will you do if this happens again?
lines.zh: : 那如果这种事再次发生，你会怎么办？

lines.en: : What will you do if there’s {i}another{/i} huge leap in time that just sets you on autopilot until you’re eventually spat back out into the world?
lines.zh: : 如果时间{i}再次{/i}大幅跳跃，让你进入自动驾驶状态，直到某天被吐回这个世界，你会怎么办？

lines.en: : Fuck if I know. But as long as I’m not blackin’ out and doin’ shit like-
lines.zh: : 鬼知道。但只要我不会昏过去干出那种——

lines.en: : Maybe that {i}is{/i} what happened in those two months.
lines.zh: : 也许那两个月里发生的{i}就是{/i}这种事。

lines.en: : Maybe {i}both{/i} of us blacked out and things just...didn’t go as poorly as they could have.
lines.zh: : 也许我们{i}俩{/i}都昏过去了，事情只是……没有变得更糟而已。

lines.en: : We were together, weren’t we? It’s possible.
lines.zh: : 我们当时在一起，不是吗？有这个可能。

lines.en: : One second, everything was normal. Or at least as normal as it {i}could{/i} have been with me admitting all of that stuff about masturbating to you and whatnot-
lines.zh: : 前一秒一切还很正常。或者说，在我向你坦白那些自慰之类的事之后，{i}能{/i}有多正常就有多正常——

lines.en: scene yumicurtain20
: Stop bringing that up!
lines.zh: : 别再提那件事了！

lines.en: : And the next second, two months of our lives were gone.
lines.zh: : 下一秒，我们人生中的两个月就没了。

lines.en: : If you’re okay with that happening again, fine. Disregard everything I’m saying and just keep living life the way you always do.
lines.zh: : 如果你能接受这种事再发生一次，那行。把我说的全当耳旁风，继续照你一直以来的方式活下去。

lines.en: scene yumicurtain21
: But if you want to take some control back into your {i}own{/i} hands...and don’t want to have any more time taken away from you...why not try and figure this out with me?
lines.zh: : 但如果你想把控制权重新握在{i}自己{/i}手里……不想再被夺走时间……为什么不跟我一起试着弄清楚呢？

lines.en: : The fuck you bein’ all serious for? It’s makin’ me uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 你他妈干嘛这么正经？让我很不舒服。

lines.en: : 'Sides, the Hell can {i}we{/i} do about this in the first place? You might be smart or whatever, but you ain’t a doctor.
lines.zh: : 再说，这事儿{i}我们{/i}又能怎么样？你也许聪明什么的，但你又不是医生。

lines.en: : No, I’m not. Nor am I whatever type of scientist handles time travel or...even a {i}teacher{/i} most of the time.
lines.zh: : 对，我不是。我也不是研究时间旅行的那类科学家，甚至大多数时候连{i}老师{/i}都算不上。

lines.en: : But I’m someone who won’t think you’re insane when you want to talk about things you don’t particularly understand.
lines.zh: : 但当你想谈论自己弄不明白的事情时，我不会觉得你疯了。

lines.en: : I don’t know if I can {i}help{/i} you, per se...but I might be able to help you feel a little less alone.
lines.zh: : 我不确定自己能不能真的{i}帮{/i}到你……但我也许能让你感觉不那么孤单。

lines.en: : Which is why I need you to sleep at my house.
lines.zh: : 所以我需要你去我家睡一晚。

lines.en: scene yumicurtain22
: Of fucking course that’s what it all comes down to. No idea why I let you just keep talkin’ me into a fuckin’ corner for so long.
lines.zh: : 他妈的果然绕到这上面来了。我真不知道自己为什么让你一路把我堵进死角这么久。

lines.en: : Hell of a charade, I’ll give ya that much. But if you’re really gonna try and {i}win me over{/i} or whatever-
lines.zh: : 这场戏演得真够绝的，这点我承认。但如果你真想{i}把我追到手{/i}什么的——

lines.en: : Sensei? What are you doing here?
lines.zh: : 老师？你在这儿干什么？

lines.en: scene yumicurtain23
: B-Better question...what are {i}you{/i} doing here? I thought you had work?
lines.zh: : 更、更好的问题是……{i}你{/i}在这儿干什么？你不是要上班吗？

lines.en: : I was able to get somebody to cover for me. Did {i}you{/i} invite Sensei over?
lines.zh: : 我找人替班了。是{i}你{/i}叫老师来的吗？

lines.en: : Course not. Dude just fuckin’ waltzed in as if he owned the place.
lines.zh: : 当然不是。这家伙就这么大摇大摆地走进来，好像这是他家似的。

lines.en: scene yumicurtain24
: So...you’re {i}not{/i} having an affair?
lines.zh: : 那么……你们{i}没有{/i}在偷情？

lines.en: : Obviously not! No!
lines.zh: : 当然没有！没有！

lines.en: scene yumicurtain25
: Great! Then it should be totally fine if I do this!
lines.zh: : 太好了！那我这么做应该完全没问题吧！

lines.en: : Do what? What are-
lines.zh: : 做什么？你这是——
